persona: 34-year-old home cook who loves Italian food, buys a few tees a year for self or gifts

designs.why: I'd buy this and gift it to a foodie friend. It looks like a vintage engraved plate from a cookbook, not a cheap novelty tee. The big serif PASTA title is bold, and the 16 shapes are easy to tell apart and labelled in clear type. Black on white will look crisp. The grid is tidy and each shape has room. A few drawings, like Radiatori and Campanelle, are busy and fine-lined, and the thin hatching may fill in or fade on cotton from a distance. The labels are small for a shirt, and $50 is a lot if it just looks like a poster on fabric.
designs.fix: Thicken the finest hatch lines and simplify the busiest shapes (Radiatori, Campanelle, Spaghetti nest) so they stay clean when printed on fabric and seen from across a room. Also make the labels a little bigger.
